name: prestashopheaven/build-tools
description: The PrestaHaven module factory: the ps-module command (checks, PHPStan per PrestaShop version, release zip with scoped packages, Docker test shops, docs, translations, publishing, git workflow, definition-of-done stamps). Successor of module-dev-tools.

suggest.phpcompatibility/php-compatibility: Require "^10.0@alpha" in the module itself (alpha stability must be allowed by the root package).
suggest.dompdf/dompdf: Last-resort PDF engine for ps-module docs (Latin, Cyrillic and Greek only) when neither Docker nor a local Chrome/Edge is available. Require it in the module (require-dev).

prestashopheaven.use-when: Building, checking, testing, documenting, releasing and publishing a PrestaHaven module or package: every ps-module command.
prestashopheaven.coverage-reason: The scripts moved from module-dev-tools 1.26 have no unit tests of their own; the definition-of-done runs of every module exercise them (verify, shops, docs, build). New code is fully unit-tested (src/mono.php). The gate rises as the tool is split into sub-tool packages (milestone M13, docs/packages/STATUS.md).
